professionalSummary: Experienced frontend developer with a focus on building accessible UI components and ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Demonstrated ability to write automated visual‑regression and accessibility tests, document components in Storybook, and support product teams in migrating legacy jQuery widgets to modern frameworks.
experienceHighlights: Built and audited form, table and dialog components to WCAG 2.1 AA at Fernhill Systems, fixing keyboard traps and missing labels found in screen‑reader testing with NVDA.
Wrote Playwright visual‑regression tests and axe‑core accessibility checks that run on every pull request to the component library.
Documented each component in Storybook with a props table, do and don’t examples and its keyboard behaviour, and answered usage questions from product teams in the library’s support channel.
Moved the booking flow off jQuery widgets for one product team, replacing them with library components written in Angular and removing the last jQuery dependency from that product’s bundle.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: a Storybook entry and pull request for an accessible date‑range picker written in Angular, with the axe‑core results, the keyboard map and the reviewer’s approval.
